import os
import subprocess
import sys

from sase.vcs_provider import get_vcs_provider

checkout_target = {{ setup.checkout_target | tojson }}
project_name = {{ setup.project_name | tojson }}
gh_ref = {{ gh_ref | tojson }}

provider = get_vcs_provider(os.getcwd())

# Checkout the PR branch so that subsequent diffs are relative to the
# PR tip rather than the default branch. Try checkout_target first
# (works for default-branch refs like origin/main), then fall back to
# Patch name -> branch name conversion.
is_patch = checkout_target == f"origin/{gh_ref}"
ok, err = provider.checkout(checkout_target, os.getcwd())
if not ok:
    if is_patch:
        # Patch ref — resolve name to branch name
        resolved = provider.resolve_revision(
            gh_ref, project_name, os.getcwd()
        )
        ok, err = provider.checkout(resolved, os.getcwd())
    else:
        # Project/repo ref — try common default branch names
        for fallback in ["master", "main"]:
            ok, err = provider.checkout(fallback, os.getcwd())
            if ok:
                break
    if not ok:
        print(
            f"Warning: checkout failed: {err}",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

# Sync with remote after checkout
subprocess.run(
    ["git", "pull", "--rebase", "--quiet"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)

# Record HEAD for the diff step
result = subprocess.run(
    ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)
head = result.stdout.strip() if result.returncode == 0 else ""
print(f"head_before={head}")
print("success=true")

head_before="{{ checkout.head_before }}"
if [ -z "$head_before" ]; then
  exit 0
fi
head_now=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
diff_dir="${SASE_TMPDIR:-${SASE_HOME:-$HOME/.sase}/tmp}/gh-diffs"
mkdir -p "$diff_dir"
diff_file=$(mktemp "$diff_dir/sase-gh-XXXXXX.diff")
if [ "$head_now" != "$head_before" ]; then
  # Commits were made — show only the last commit's diff
  git diff HEAD~1 HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  commit_msg=$(git log -1 --format='%s' HEAD)
  echo "meta_commit_message=$commit_msg"
else
  # No commits — show uncommitted changes
  git diff HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z 2>/dev/null \
    | while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
        git diff --no-index /dev/null "$f" 2>/dev/null
      done >> "$diff_file"
fi
if [ -s "$diff_file" ]; then
  echo "diff_path=$diff_file"
else
  rm -f "$diff_file"
fi

# Stash any uncommitted changes (including untracked files)
if ! git diff --quiet HEAD 2>/dev/null || [ -n "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard)" ]; then
  git stash push --include-untracked -m "gh-workflow-$(date +%s)" --quiet
  echo "stashed=true"
else
  echo "stashed=false"
fi
git fetch origin --quiet 2>&1 || true
git pull --rebase --quiet 2>/dev/null || true
echo "success=true"

from sase_github.scripts.gh_setup import main
main(
    gh_ref={{ gh_ref | tojson }},
    n={{ n | tojson }},
    release={{ release | tojson }},
    workflow_label={{ workflow_label | tojson }},
)

**Recommended solution:** show a live Wells Fargo checking *close* on the existing Bank Period Charts header. Draw it at read time. Leave period-note Markdown unchanged, and keep daily notes badge-only.

The idea is sound. Period notes already answer *when money moved* (badge + charts) and still omit *how much checking held*. That stock figure is almost absent from the UI today: `bob bank report -p 2026-W46` prints `WF Checking ✓ balanced · Nov 16` with no dollar, and the month card shows status chips, not `$7,760.04`.

The request as written needs a few strictures:

- **See it on the note, do not write it into the note.** Period scaffolds are create-only, and bank totals are already drawn live. A hardcoded Sunday close would go stale on the next import.
- **Claim Friday when coverage only reaches Friday.** Live W46 is Nov 9–15, but QFX coverage and `LEDGERBAL` stop at **2026-11-13** (`$7,760.04`, `balanced`). Wells Fargo QFX is one snapshot per download, not a daily close series. Honest copy today is `$7,760.04 as of Fri 13`.
- **Keep it off the Bank Badge and off the stats facts.** Badge In/Out exclude transfers; a checking close includes them. The badge also follows daily notes, which you excluded.
- **Hero is default checking** (`WF Checking`). Other accounts belong in the tooltip. Net worth, briefs, Stats, and Mac stay out (the `bob-cli-ku` privacy rule).

bob already has the reconstruction: opening from the first QFX `LEDGERBAL` minus journaled postings, then walk forward. Emit additive `closings[]` on `bob bank report`; the plugin paints the resting header readout (the slot that is empty until hover today). Collapsed, the dollar remains. Quiet weeks with `$0` flow still show the close.
